clues.it: Vito era accanto a un barile e a ovest di Irene.
clues.en: Vito was beside a barrel and west of Irene.

clues.it: Marta era nella 3ª colonna, accanto a una corda e a ovest di Luca.
clues.en: Marta was in the 3rd column, beside a rope coil and west of Luca.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 1ª colonna e a nord di Irene.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 1st column and north of Irene.

clues.it: Irene era nella 4ª riga, a nord di Luca e da sola in Stiva.
clues.en: Irene was in the 4th row, north of Luca and alone in the Hold.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Carla era esattamente una riga a nord di Fabio e da sola in Plancia.
clues.en: Carla was exactly one row north of Fabio and alone on the Bridge.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 4ª colonna e nella 7ª riga, ma non era accanto a un barile.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 4th column and in the 7th row, but was not beside a barrel.

clues.it: Luca era nella 7ª colonna e accanto a un barile, ma non era accanto a una sedia.
clues.en: Luca was in the 7th column and beside a barrel, but was not beside a chair.

clues.it: Nino era in Cabina, ma non era accanto a un salvagente.
clues.en: Nino was in the Cabin, but was not beside a life ring.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Marta lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Marta's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 3rd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Irene lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Irene's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 7ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Fabio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 7th, column 4th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca lascia una sola casella libera: riga 8ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 8th, column 7th.

steps.it: Carla può stare solo nella 6ª riga.
steps.en: Carla can only be in the 6th row.

steps.it: Marta può stare solo nella 2ª riga: escludendola, a Sergio resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Marta can only be in the 2nd row: ruling it out leaves Sergio a single square: row 3rd, column 1st.

steps.it: Irene può stare solo nella 9ª colonna: escludendola, a Carla resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Irene can only be in the 9th column: ruling it out leaves Carla a single square: row 6th, column 8th.

steps.it: Luca può stare solo nella 8ª riga: escludendola, a Nino resta una sola casella: riga 9ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Luca can only be in the 8th row: ruling it out leaves Nino a single square: row 9th, column 6th.

steps.it: Nino può stare solo nella 9ª riga: escludendola, a Vito resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Nino can only be in the 9th row: ruling it out leaves Vito a single square: row 1st, column 2nd.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 5ª colonna, e lì a Tea resta una sola casella libera: la 5ª riga.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 5th column, and it leaves Tea a single free square there: the 5th row.
